phytophthora_root_heart_rot.name: Phytophthora heart/root rot

evidence.claim: Free water needed for sporangia/zoospores; worse in restricted drainage; root rot serious in prolonged wet weather

limitations: Paper gives no numeric rainfall thresholds; parameters are PRELIMINARY placeholders needing local validation
Soil-borne: drainage, planting depth, soil pH matter and are not weather-derived

evidence.claim: Material removed in showery weather and heaped is prone; conidia form at high humidity; avoid planting in wet weather

fruitlet_core_rot.name: Fruitlet core rot / leathery pocket (Penicillium funiculosum)

evidence.claim: Infection favoured by 16-20 C in the 5 weeks after flower initiation and ~10-15 weeks after induction

limitations: Sporadic; mites/leaf-hair damage also involved; output capped at moderate
Band comes from a general review, not Northeast India field data

fusariosis.name: Fusariosis (Fusarium guttiforme)

evidence.claim: Risk higher when flowers initiate and fruit mature under warm conditions; entry mainly via insect injuries/planting material

limitations: 'Warm' is not numeric in the source; 24 C and window weeks are PRELIMINARY
Insects and planting material dominate; weather cannot establish infection

mealybug_wilt.name: Mealybug wilt (virus via mealybugs/ants)

evidence.claim: Driven by vector numbers, ant activity, planting material; symptoms most obvious in winter

limitations: No weather-risk relationship supplied; needs pest scouting

leaf_blight.name: Leaf blight (image-dataset class)

evidence.claim: Visually defined class; cites Lasiodiplodia theobromae (ref 9) but gives no weather data

limitations: No weather evidence in supplied papers; do not equate with white leaf spot

Pineapple_fusarium.note: PLDD describes leaf yellowing; Joy & Sindhu describe fruit/stem disease. Equivalence unverified.
